description: This file contains a PHP unit test class EmployeeSkillAPITest for testing the EmployeeSkillAPI class in the OrangeHRM project. The tests cover CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions related to employee skills within the HR management system.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeSkillAPI endpoints including CRUD operations and validation logic.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillService
methods.description: Tests that EmployeeSkillAPI correctly returns an instance of EmployeeSkillService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee skill by ID, verifying normalization and meta data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the API request validation rules for retrieving a single employee skill.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee skill and verifies the response normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the API request validation rules for updating an employee skill.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting employee skills and verifies the response.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the API request validation rules for deleting employee skills.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee skill and verifies the response.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the API request validation rules for creating an employee skill.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all employee skills for an employee, including pagination details.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the API request validation rules for fetching all employee skills.
